title: Work Schedule (Demo)
description: Fill in your week so other departments (like Meal Planner) can plan around your busy days and prep windows.

sections.title: Week Setup
sections.description: Capture the fixed shape of the week first.

blocks.title: Cross-Module Tip
blocks.text: Meal Planner can use this week's busy days, work window, and artifacts when planning low-effort meals.

sections.title: Planning Board
sections.description: Lay out deadlines, blocks, and the draft schedule.

blocks.title: Schedule Timeline
blocks.empty: Add lines like 09:00 | Deep work or [Mon] Project review to preview them here.

sections.title: Constraints & Handoff
sections.description: Keep blockers and cross-module artifacts in one place.

fields.label: Timezone
fields.help: Use the timezone that the rest of your week should be planned in.

fields.label: Work window
fields.help: Summarize the normal working pattern in one line.

fields.label: Non-negotiables
fields.help: List anything that must happen and cannot be moved.

fields.label: Projects (with deadlines)
fields.placeholder:
- Project A: deadline
- Project B: deadline

fields.label: This week's focus (top 3)
fields.help: These are the most important outcomes for the week.

fields.label: Draft schedule notes
fields.placeholder: Blocks, deep work windows, breaks, admin time...

fields.label: Risks / conflicts
fields.help: Useful for Bookkeeper debriefs and cross-module awareness.

fields.label: Artifacts (optional)
